about: What the rules in generate.mjs can't see in cmangos.json, each with its reason. "instances" names the area that names an instance when its map has none; "quests" sets a quest's dungeon ("dungeon": a map, or null for none) or leaves it out of every chain ("skip": true). generate.mjs refuses a review that only repeats the rules, and one for a quest cmangos.json no longer has.
